{{Quote|That's when we met the traveler and he told us to find you.|Micah's father|<ref name="The Way Out" />}}
During the [[Imperial Era]], a '''traveler''' encountered a couple that were fleeing the [[Galactic Empire]] after it sought to take their son [[Micah]]. In response, he directed them to the location of an individual known as "the Healer," who was in actuality the former [[Jedi]] [[Barriss Offee]].<ref name="The Way Out" />
